name: BACH_0258
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (61%)** · Unreliable input · Defer to expert
InSitu (34%) stays in the 90% set [F1], all neighbors are InSitu, and frozen-section quality failed.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Top probabilities | Benign 61%, InSitu 34%, Normal 4%, Invasive 2% | Split between Benign and InSitu |
| Conformal set | Benign, InSitu (90% coverage) | Cannot exclude InSitu at 90% |
| Reliability / OOD | 30% reliability, 100% OOD [F6] | Flagged atypical input; low trust |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Disagree | Models pick different top classes |
| Similar cases | 0/5 Benign (all InSitu, 82%–85%) [F5] | Neighbors contradict Benign call |

## Tissue evidence
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (regions 7, 10) · context · Above-typical; weight (-0.62) pushes against invasion [F2] · Weak
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 4, 7, 10) · ↑ invasive · Above-typical (+0.26) [F3]; unreliable (0/20 spot check) · Unreliable
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 7) · ↓ invasive · Typical score; negative weight (-0.24) [F4] · Validated
- **Tumor cell fraction** (regions 1, 5, 6) · context · 93% neoplastic (100th percentile) [F7]; 76 µm² nuclei (93rd) [F8] · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing top-risk regions drops invasive probability beyond random removal (CI +0.002 to +0.020), supporting faithfulness.
- **Concepts**: Concept removal matches random noise (CI -0.009 to +0.006); mitoses (0/20) and necrosis (3/20) are unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- Regions 1, 5, 6 are InSitu carcinoma, matching all 5 nearest neighbors and 93% neoplastic cells.
- Flagged frozen-section quality (30% reliability) masks atypia or margin involvement [F12]; recut and deeper levels drafted.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 5, 6, 1**: Highest risk (26% in 5), 76–95 neoplastic nuclei/region, 0% benign epithelium [F11].
2. **Regions 7, 10, 4**: Check lymphocytes and verify true mitoses (unreliable concept, 0/20 spot check).
3. **Regions 1, 11**: Check duct-confined atypia (region 1, vs InSitu BACH_0041) and stroma (region 11).
